name: Vincent M. Tentindo
tagline: Top rated Workers' Compensation attorney in Boston, Massachusetts
side_practice_areas: Workers' Compensation, Employment & Labor, Personal Injury
about: Vincent M. Tentindo stands as a luminary in the legal domain, leveraging a robust career spanning over three decades and a reputation characterized by legal excellence and leadership. Since 2000, he has held the esteemed position of managing partner at Tentindo, Kendall, Canniff & Keefe, LLP, located in Boston, Massachusetts. With a focus on representing employers and insurers, he brings forth a wealth of experience in defending a spectrum of claims encompassing workers’ compensation and employment discrimination.

Securing his Bachelor of Arts degree, Mr. Tentindo graduated from Boston College in 1975 and later completed his Doctor of Jurisprudence from the Suffolk University Law School in 1978. He was admitted to the Massachusetts Bar in 1978 and holds admission to the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts and the U.S. Supreme Court.

Governor Deval Patrick appointed Mr. Tentindo as a member of the Judicial Nominating Committee of the Department of Industrial Accidents, a testament to his authority and knowledge in the domain. He further contributes to the legal community as a member of the board of directors of the Self Insurance Group Association of Massachusetts.

Mr. Tentindo’s accolades and recognitions are a testament to the exceptional legal acumen he has garnered over the years. His dedication to educating and advancing the field is evidenced through his frequent lectures and authored articles on workers’ compensation and disability law. His commitment to the advancement of legal education extends to his role as an adjunct professor at the New England Law | Boston. He has also received a “Good” rating on Avvo.

A prestigious acknowledgment of his professional aptitude and ethics, Mr. Tentindo’s unwavering commitment to excellence has earned him a peer-review rating of AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell. Moreover, he is a distinguished Fellow of the College of Workers’ Compensation Lawyers and actively contributes to legal discourse as a member of the DRI Workers’ Compensation Committee.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
